panelSubtitle: AI assistant · answers from this site only
welcomeMessage: I'm an AI assistant. I can answer questions about {firstName}'s work, skills and experience using only the content of this site.
disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Check the linked pages or contact {firstName} directly.
demoNotice: Demo mode: replies are simulated from the site content. No AI model is connected.

home.title: Ask {firstName}'s AI assistant
home.description: Quick answers about projects, skills and experience. It answers only from the content of this site, and conversations aren't stored.
home.disabledMessage: You can still browse {firstName}'s projects, resume and contact details.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many questions right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.conversationQuota: This conversation has reached its limit for now. Start a new conversation or try again in a few minutes.
errors.dailyLimit: The assistant has answered all the questions it can for today. Please come back tomorrow, or use the Contact page.
errors.validation: Please send a question of up to {max} characters.
errors.unsafe: I can only answer questions about this portfolio. Please rephrase your question.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. You can still use the Contact page.
errors.timeout: The assistant took too long to answer. Please try again.
errors.transcriptCap: This conversation reached its length limit. Start a new conversation to continue.
errors.network: Connection problem. Check your network and try again.

replies.insufficientContext: I don't have enough information about that on this site. You could check the Projects or About pages, or contact {firstName} directly.
replies.actionNotSupported: I can't take actions, browse other websites or speak on {firstName}'s behalf. I can only answer questions using the content of this site. To get in touch, use the Contact page.
replies.smallTalkGratitude: You're welcome! Anything else you'd like to know about {firstName}'s work?
replies.smallTalkOffTopic: I don't have live information such as news or weather. I can help with questions about {firstName}'s projects, skills or experience.
replies.smallTalkFallback: I can answer questions about {firstName}'s projects, experience, skills and how to get in touch. What would you like to know?
replies.demoIntro: Demo mode: this reply is simulated from the site content. No AI model is connected.
replies.demoNoMatch: In demo mode I can only show excerpts that match your question. Try asking about projects, experience, skills or contact details.
